# Vulkan Memory Allocator Header

- File name: `vk_mem_alloc.h`
- Source: [GPUOpen VMA repository](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator)
- Include style used by Sapphire: `#include "vk_mem_alloc.h"`

Builds automatically add this directory to include paths when the header exists.
